content.description: Tact Language is a smart contract language. Tact is a language for writing efficient and safe smart contracts in TON. Its role is developer productivity: clearer contract code, stronger abstractions, and TON-specific compilation. Tact Language fits developer tooling because it helps teams build, debug, deploy, index, or inspect TON applications more reliably. Tact Language is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
